function.name: image_resize
function.description: Resize an image stored as a site Image, CmsFile, or FileIO file while preserving its aspect ratio. The result overwrites the source unless SaveAs is provided, and the saved path is returned.

width.description: Nonnegative integer width in pixels, default 0. Set 0 to calculate from height. At least one of width or height must be greater than 0.

height.description: Nonnegative integer height in pixels, default 0. Set 0 to calculate from width. At least one of width or height must be greater than 0.

saveAs.description: Optional output path. When omitted, the source image is overwritten.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
